answers.rationale: The effective_rate relation establishes job J1 at 240 currency units per hour (TOW rate after service conditions).
For job J4 (service_code ASST), effective_rate applies the ESCORT rate_card row at 180 per hour per service conditions section 4.
Three jobs (J5, J6, J7) have no row in the billable_hours relation, which records established billable hours; J6 also has a blank billed_hours field on tow_job.
job_charge establishes 2280 for J2: 8 hours at 240/hr plus 1 hour overtime at 1.5x for vessel V-BAY day total exceeding 8 hours.
No relation in the World establishes a fuel surcharge for any job; J3's job_charge of 240 is based solely on 2 hours at 120/hr with no surcharge component.

J7 is at berth B12 starting at 20:00 (after 18:00) with service TOW; billing_outcome is insufficient_evidence and purpose_requirement_failure records that no emergency documentation is attached for B12 after-hours commercial towing.
